name: Arcforge: World Heritage Games
subtitle: Games from every heritage
shortDescription: Over 250 world heritage games to learn and play. Free to play, earn ad-free months by watching, or go ad-free monthly. Works offline.
longDescription:
Arcforge is a growing collection of games from the heritage of every culture: board, card, dice, tile, puzzle, dexterity and team-sport traditions, each explained so anyone can learn it. These are real games that real people still play, and each Rules page states any simplification we made. Every game has an About page that says where it comes from and how it is played. No accounts, and everything plays offline.

### How It Works
Every game is free to play, with short ads that help keep it free. Want fewer ads? Earn ad-free play for the month in any game by watching optional short videos; progress is shown and resets monthly. Prefer to pay? An optional per-game monthly subscription, Go ad-free every month, removes ads in that game. Nobody needs to pay to play, and earlier one-time unlocks stay ad-free for good.

### Learn As You Play
Every game has a Rules page and a How to Play guide, with text size up to 300%. Auto Play (Watch & Learn) lets the computer play and explain its choices, and you can pause it or ask for a hint.

### Board Games of the World
Chess (India), Go, Shogi, Xiangqi, Makruk, Janggi, Renju, Hasami Shogi, Dame, Seega, Alquerque, Ludus Latrunculorum (Rome), Reversi, Halma, Jungle and Chaturanga, Turkish Dama, Kharbaga, Zamma, Peralikatuma, Co Ganh and Yote. Hunt, capture and mill games: Tiger and Goat, Fox and Geese, Hare and Hounds, Tafl, Konane, Nine Men's Morris, Morabaraba, Fanorona and Sholo Guti and Lau Kata Kati.

### Sowing Games
Oware (West Africa), Congklak, Toguz Kumalak, Bao la Kiswahili, O An Quan, Gabata and Hawalis, played by sowing seeds.

### Dice and Race Games
Pachisi and Snakes & Ladders (India), the Royal Game of Ur, Senet (Ancient Egypt), Tavla, Yut Nori, Parques, Shagai, Mehen, Shut the Box and Sahkku, Daldos, Game of the Goose and Patolli.

### Card and Tile Games
Baloot (the Gulf), Tarneeb (the Levant), Durak, Scopa, Truco, Loteria, Okey, Domino Cubano, Mahjong (China), Carrom, Dudo and Morra and Mheibes.

### Team Sports
Take one role while the computer plays the rest of the field: football, basketball 3x3, volleyball, American football, hurling (Ireland), Chogan, Kabaddi, Sepak Takraw, cricket, Ampe, Matkot and Kok-boru, Buzkashi and Cirit.

### Sports and Skill
Tennis, Table Tennis, Badminton, Baseball, Datse archery (Bhutan), Mini Golf Links, Ski Jump, Rugby Conversion, Dragon Boat Race and Tent Pegging, Mallakhamb, Glima, Kurash, Ssireum, Wave Riding, Sled Dog Race and Sack Race.

### Dexterity and Lawn Games
Kubb, cornhole, Sapo, Tumbang Preso, Diketo, Gonggi, Ken and Ball, Kegeln, Petanque, Crokinole, darts, Bocce, diabolo, Ddakji, Gilli-Danda, Marbles, Conkers, snooker, curling and Sjoelen, Tejo, Gorodki and more.

### Puzzles and Words
Tangram and Huarong Dao, Nonogram and Sudoku, Peg Solitaire, Kolam, Chinese Rings, Abacus, Labyrinth (Crete), Crossword, Tower of Hanoi, Sure Sweep, Crown Fields, Word Game and Lo Shu Magic Square and Hashi Bridges.

### Rhythm and Music
Taiko, Koto, Djembe, Kora, Gamelan, Oud and Launeddas Triple Pipe, Sega Ravanne Drum and Santoor.

### Crafts
Origami, Kintsugi and Bonsai (Japan), Ink Brush and Paper Cutting (China), Pottery Wheel, Quilt Patterns and Maamoul Cookie Moulding and Kantha Quilt.

### Journeys and Stories
Silk Road Trader, Pearl Diving, Dhow Sailing, Rice Terraces, Anansi Tales and Pinisi and Kamishibai.

### Arcforge Originals
Golden Sling (a slingshot skill game with a new Daily Hunt every day), Perch, One Arrow Oath, Kite Duel, Steppe Eagle Hunting and The Road to Lanka, an illustrated story adventure.
